images.prompt: Actual gameplay view, not poster, no device frame. Stealth game screenshot, high three-quarter top-down camera over a Korean apartment master bedroom at 3 a.m. A middle-aged man sleeps on his back under a slate-blue duvet, the duvet visibly rising with his breath; cold moonlight falls through window blinds and paints hard diagonal stripes across the floorboards and bed. A small warm amber bedside lamp glow pools on a wooden nightstand holding a gold wristwatch and reading glasses. A black-gloved thief's hand, rim-lit by moonlight, reaches in from the lower right. Stylized semi-realistic painterly 3D, deep navy and indigo palette with a single amber accent, fine film grain, heavy vignette. Bottom HUD: a wide breath-monitor waveform with glowing teal exhale windows and a white NOW line, a 'breath hold' bar and a 'noise' bar. Top-left title '숨소리 도둑', floating item tag '손목시계 훔치기', phase readout '내쉼'. Clean, minimal, tense, cinematic.
